digest: cc-smith: Indian credit-card app. Checkout Advisor (which card), Card Finder (which to get), Notices (only about your own cards, plus a launch notice when a new card would earn >= Rs 2,000/yr and >= 15% of its fee incl GST), Market (Offers for you, New launches, What changed). Facts only from verbatim quotes on official bank pages; non-official = 'Reported'. SerpApi use (verified in code, backend/src/cc_smith/signals/sources.py, knowledge/discover.py, ops/serp.py): Launch Radar daily: google_news q='launches new credit card India when:30d'; google_ads_transparency_center for sbicard.com, hdfcbank.com, icicibank.com, axisbank.com region 2356 last 30 days, new = first shown in 14 days; ..._ad_details for up to 2 creatives per bank, image read by Haiku vision; google search site:<bank domain> to find official page/PDF. Gateway: rejects personal data, cache per flow (launch_radar 7 days), budgets per flow (card_profile 70, launch_radar 45, cap_watch 25, checkout_merchant 15, commerce_offers 10, dev 35; 50 demo reserve), ledger. Today: 26 live, 67 cached, all launch_radar; 224 left this month. Checkout/Finder do not call SerpApi. Today's 6 leads are all 'Reported' (none confirmed); launch notice shown only in test data. Bureau fetch and SMS/email budget import are simulated; the voiceover says so, the screens do not. Demo figures: Swiggy Rs 1,200 -> HSBC Live+ Rs 120, Rs 60 more than Millennia; Finder Rs 32,800/yr today, best move +Rs 5,912 add Swiggy BLCK. Deadline 2026-10-10 18:00 IST, video under 3 minutes.
